name: kayak-trip-planner
description: Plans sea kayak trips in US waters: checks NOAA tides and currents, the NWS marine forecast, buoys and daylight, compares them with ACA and Paddle UK reference conditions for your experience level, suggests a day, launch time and route direction, and lists exactly what each plan is based on. A planning tool, not a safety system; skips days with a Small Craft Advisory or stronger. You are responsible for your own safety (see TERMS.md).
